title: Context item write bodies and command receipts v1
description: Five existing write operations. Root is the complete success receipt union; HTTP bodies use the operation-specific request anchors. A receipt is historical command metadata, not the current item or a read-only lookup result.
$comment: Source-only. Load this resource, context-history.json and context-item-read.json locally under their IDs. Runtime remains authoritative for UTF-16 lengths, lone surrogates, calendar validity, input normalization, cross-header/body equality, original identity/key/fingerprint, exact path/version/ETag/source bindings and transactional authorization. No validator, generator or runtime evidence. Existing SDK commands use generic envelope checks rather than this complete receipt schema.

text.$comment: Runtime rejects NUL and lone surrogates and measures UTF-16 length. Other control characters are not blanket-rejected by boundedText; do not substitute the narrower sync identifier rules.

idempotencyKey.$comment: Existing validateIdempotencyKey checks nonempty, <=255 UTF-16 units and no whitespace. It does not independently reject every control or lone surrogate in a JSON-body key; downstream HTTP/database constraints can be narrower. Preserve the exact original key.

inputExpiry.$comment: Raw input accepts four-digit UTC years, optional 1..3 fractional digits or null. Runtime checks valid calendar seconds and normalizes to millisecond Date.toISOString. It does not require future expiry for ordinary create/update.

writeSourceRef.$comment: Fields are preserved without trimming, URI syntax validation, source deduplication or fetching. Create/update accept revision omitted or zero, even for a context-item source; live use/confirmation imposes stricter local pin rules later.

title.description: Runtime checks raw length then trims outer whitespace.

content.description: Nonblank text; preserve whitespace exactly. Unlike legacy read snapshots, write input is a string.

item_type.description: Runtime checks raw length then trims outer whitespace.

confidence.description: Any finite input in range; normalized with Math.round(value*1000)/1000, not rejected for extra decimals.

editableFields.$comment: Internal open input fields. Public body anchors close unknown fields. Defaults apply only to create; update omission preserves values except its documented status reset.

item_id.description: Legacy HTTP compatibility only: route parameters overwrite this optional body's value before the handler, even if it differs or is not a string. Omit it in new requests; it cannot bind or redirect the path. No type restriction describes the actual ignored JSON field.

versionedControlFields.$comment: Versioned operations need a positive expected version from this body or If-Match/If-Match-Version. Idempotency key must appear in body or header. All simultaneously supplied values must agree. JSON Schema alone cannot enforce alternatives involving HTTP headers.

ContextCreateBody.description: Raw create HTTP object. Body key optional only when supplied by Idempotency-Key header; both must match. No caller item ID, expected_version or status. Runtime assigns ULID/version 1/proposed. Defaults are annotations here, actually applied by parseCreateContextItem.

ContextUpdateBody.description: At least one real patch field; controls alone are insufficient. Classification cannot change. Omitted status preserves excluded, otherwise resets to proposed, including edits of confirmed/expired records. An accepted no-op patch still increments the version.

ContextArchiveBody.description: Object required, including {} when both key and expected version are supplied in headers. New command requires an active item and records excluded plus archive time.

ContextRestoreBody.description: Object required, including {} with header controls. New command requires an archived item, clears archive time and remains excluded. It does not restore prior approval or source freshness.

ContextConfirmBody.description: Raw reason is length-checked then trimmed. New confirmation requires a verified human reviewer, proposed unexpired item and current strict local-source closure. External evidence is not fetched or authenticated.

ContextItemMutationReceipt.$comment: Historical operation metadata only, without content, current status, actor/client/key echo or confirmation reason. replayed=false is a newly persisted command; true preserves original version/event/time. No dedicated complete runtime receipt parser is added by this schema.

trace_id.description: This attempt's request trace, including replay. The event trace remains the original stored trace and is not returned in this receipt.

mutationEnvelope.$comment: Outer revision=data.version=sole source revision and source ID=data.item_id; ETag=buildEtag(data.version), also sent as HTTP ETag. server_cursor is the original command event's cursor, not a new stream watermark. Replay may return an older ETag/version than the current item. Request operation/path and all cross-field equality need runtime/client checks.
